test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate article.

The committee deliberated extensively over whether ______ increase in tuition fees was justifiable given the prevailing economic climate.
solution:
The correct answer is '**an**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The blank in the sentence is followed by the word "**increase**," which starts with a vowel sound.
 
• The appropriate article for words beginning with a vowel sound is "**an**."
 
• Options **"a"** and **"the"** are incorrect because they do not fit grammatically in this context.
